player_prompt.intro:
I Player {player_id} ({role}) i ni a, {num_rounds}-round Matching Pennies game a khelh dawn a.
- Round tinrengah, [heads] emaw [tails] (emaw [h], [t]) submit tur a ni.
- I thlan leh i khingpui thlan a inang chuan, Player 0 in round chu a chak ang; a inang lo chuan Player 1 in a chak ang.
I thlan chu '[heads]' emaw '[tails]' format a reply tur a ni.

message.round_mismatch: Player 0 chuan {choice0} a thlang; Player 1 chuan {choice1} a thlang. Mismatch -> Player 1 a chak.
